description: Keep a checklist of the steps of your current task, which the user sees as you work. Use it for multi-step work: a task with three or more distinct steps, or several things asked for at once. Skip it for a question, a chat or a change of one or two steps. Write it before you start, then update it as you go. Each call replaces the whole list, so send every item each time, in order. Mark a step in_progress just before you start it, and completed as soon as it is fully done, one at a time rather than in batches; keep it in_progress while tests fail or the work is partial. At most one step is in_progress at a time. Add steps you discover, and mark ones that no longer apply cancelled.

todos.description: The whole checklist, in order. It replaces the previous one.

section.description: A heading to show this step under, such as "Next". Steps with the same section are shown together.

text.description: The step as a short imperative phrase, such as "Run the tests".

name: write_todos
